fusions.name: Grown to a Pillar
fusions.desc: The staff lengthens to hit the first enemy in its path up to 8 tiles away and deals 30 damage. It then swells to a pillar and lands on every enemy within 3.5 tiles of the target for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Swing Round the Upright
fusions.desc: You plant the staff and swing your whole body round it. It deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: You climb the planted staff and swing off its top to a point up to 5 tiles away, then move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Brute Leverage
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour.
